method: Every factual sentence and subsidiary attribute maps to exact submitted passages plus the complete researcher pages and independent reporting observation. The source-budget record maps all visitor-visible text and counts paraphrases. Site totals, edit totals, unique agents, incidents, event dates and company attribution remain separate. No keys or bypass instructions are included.

supports.passage: 9 September Kenneth Degraff reported that AI agents scoured the web for user API keys left unguarded.
